  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="head">
      <div><p class="kick">BIM automation</p><h2>Scripts that take on the <em>repetitive work.</em></h2></div>
      <p class="lead">We build custom Revit, Dynamo and Python tools that streamline BIM workflows, remove manual tasks and give engineers their time back for the work that needs judgement.</p>

    <div class="autog">
      <div class="autoc">
        <article class="auto"><span class="an">01</span><h3>Revit add-ins and pyRevit</h3><p>Buttons on your own Revit toolbar for the tasks your team repeats every day, built around your standards.</p></article>
        <article class="auto"><span class="an">02</span><h3>Dynamo scripts</h3><p>Visual scripts for placing, numbering, renaming and checking elements across a whole model in one run.</p></article>
        <article class="auto"><span class="an">03</span><h3>Python automation</h3><p>Batch processing across many sheets and files: dimensions, tags, sheets, views, exports and data.</p></article>
        <ul class="autol" aria-label="What we automate"><li>Automatic dimensioning</li><li>Sheet and view creation</li><li>CAD to BIM conversion</li><li>Parameters and schedules</li><li>Model QA checks</li><li>Batch exports</li></ul>
        <div class="autobs"><button type="button" class="btn autob" data-store><svg aria-hidden="true"><use href="#ic-bag"/></svg>Open the script store</button><a class="btn ghost autob" href="#contact">Discuss a custom tool</a></div>
      </div>
      <figure class="code" aria-label="Example of a Revit Python script">
        <div class="cbar"><i></i><i></i><i></i><span>auto_dimension.py</span></div>
<pre><code><span class="ck">from</span> pyrevit <span class="ck">import</span> revit, forms
<span class="cc"># Dimension every grid on the selected sheets</span>
sheets = forms.select_sheets(title=<span class="cs">"Sheets to dimension"</span>)
<span class="ck">with</span> revit.Transaction(<span class="cs">"Auto dimensions"</span>):
    <span class="ck">for</span> sheet <span class="ck">in</span> sheets:
        <span class="ck">for</span> view <span class="ck">in</span> placed_views(sheet):
            grids = collect_grids(view)
            add_dimensions(view, grids)
forms.alert(<span class="cs">"Done. Sheets dimensioned."</span>)</code></pre>
      </figure>
